_comment: Hand-drawn region polygons for the White Mountains, as [lat, lon] rings.
Boundaries follow the notches and highways the AMC guide's sections are
organised around, because those are what actually separate one range from
the next: Franconia Notch (I-93) at lon -71.685, Crawford Notch (Rt 302)
as the diagonal through -71.47/-71.28, Pinkham Notch (Rt 16) at -71.21,
the Wild River valley at -71.03, Evans Notch (Rt 113) further east, Rt 2
across the north at lat 44.37, and the Kancamagus across the south at
These are approximations drawn by hand, not surveyed lines. A trail that
crosses a boundary belongs to both regions it touches, so a boundary being
